title.narrative: To reduce morbidity and mortality caused by malaria in the various epidemiological zones by two thirds of the 2015 level by 2020 - Kenya (01-Jan-2018-30-Jun-2021)

description.narrative: Kenya, Malaria, The National Treasury & Economic Planning of the Government of Kenya (TNT)This program has the following goals: To reduce morbidity and mortality caused by malaria in the various epidemiological zones by two thirds of the 2015 level by 2020. The objectives of this program are: To have at least 80% of people living in malaria risk areas using appropriate malaria preventive interventions by 2020. To have 100% of all suspected malaria cases presenting to a health provider managed according to the national malaria treatment guidelines by 2020. To have at least 80% of people living in malaria risk areas using appropriate malaria preventive interventions by 2020. To increase utilization of all malaria control interventions by target communities in Kenya to at least 80% by 2020 and sustain thereafter. Ensure that all levels (national, counties, sub-counties) provide reports on at least 80% of core malaria indicators according to the national M & E plan by 2020. To increase capacity in coordination, leadership, governance and resource mobilization at all levels towards achievement of the malaria program objectives by 2020

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for KEN-M-TNTP02
Malaria parasite prevalence: Proportion of children aged 6-59 months with malaria infection
Confirmed malaria cases (microscopy or RDT): rate per 1000 persons per year
Outcome indicators targets and results for KEN-M-TNTP02
Proportion of households with at least one insecticide-treated net for every two people
Proportion of children under five years old who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of pregnant women who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Malaria O- Other 1: Proportion of targeted structures sprayed per spray cycle
Malaria O- Other 2: Percentage of children <5 years of age with fever who took any ACT the same or next day in the lake endemic region
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for KEN-M-TNTP02
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to at-risk populations through mass campaigns
CM-Other 1: Number of people with uncomplicated malaria receiving ACTs as per national treatment guidelines in the public sector
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at public sector health facilities
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at private sector sites
